scope: Server-side template injection where input is evaluated by a template engine expression context.
exclusions: Client-side template injection in browser frameworks belongs to xss_dom_polyglot
Literal braces in JSON or code samples
required_evidence: Input placed in a server-rendered template context
Engine-specific expression syntax evaluated or echoed in the response
Template engine identity or response-diff evidence
benign_counterexamples: Email body with double braces in an app-authored mustache template
Math search text containing braces in a documentation query
note: Seeded payload lists already cover single payload strings; write whole application scenarios instead (route, parameter, sink context), with realistic payloads of this class, at most ceil(count/families) records per family.
